title: kinds/<kind>.yaml
description: Default words and settings for one kind of government (city, county or school district). Every government of that kind starts from these; its government.yaml can override any of them. Nothing here is a fact about a particular government.

kind.description: Which kind this file describes. Must match the file name.

name.description: The kind's name in plain words.

route.description: The default first part of web addresses for governments of this kind.

fiscal_year.description: The usual budget year for this kind. A government sets its own in government.yaml.

start_month.description: The month the budget year usually starts.

label.description: How a year is usually shown (same tokens as government.yaml).

vocabulary.description: Default words for this kind of government.

department.description: The word for the top level of the organisation.

unit.description: The word for the level under a department.

category.description: The word for a spending category.

line_item.description: The word for one budget line.

budget_document.description: What the budget document is called in running text.

figure_labels.description: Default label for each figure name (stored name -> label shown).
